1416|c14f3f06.name: Grimand Elmore
1416|c14f3f06.text:
If you've come looking for the finest craftsmanship on this or any other continent in the world, then you've come to the right place!

Grimand Elmore, at your service!

14450|d3e1a5a0.name: Orphan Matron Nightingale
14450|d3e1a5a0.text:
There are costs with war, $c... ones often overlooked.  Those costs are the orphans - children who have lost their parents to the far-too-numerous conflicts that rage across Azeroth.  Those children who have no one else to turn to often come here to live until they are old enough to fend for themselves.

One week out of the year during the Spring, the Alliance takes time to give something back to these innocents.  This time is called Children's Week.

331|9c6df40b.name: Maginor Dumas
331|9c6df40b.text: Greetings $c.  Shall I provide you with further insight into the world of magic?

5566|fb513610.name: Tannysa
5566|fb513610.text: I hope that your interruption is for a good cause, I was in the middle of some important work.

1078-accept.name: Collin Mauren
1078-accept.text:
Travelers keep asking me about the Stonetalon Mountains. It seems to be a popular place for adventure--it doesn't matter if you're seeking wyvern, elementals, or you have business with the Venture Co.

Within the Charred Vale, deep in Stonetalon, there used to be a species of basilisks whose scales, when ground to dust, made a wonderful reagent for some spells I've created.

If those basilisks still live, I would love to have a few of their scales.

Take your time, it is no rush, but I can pay well.
1078-accept.title: Retrieval for Mauren

135-complete.name: Master Mathias Shaw
135-complete.text: This matter might be more complex than Stoutmantle realizes.
135-complete.title: The Defias Brotherhood

135-progress.name: Master Mathias Shaw
135-progress.text: What business do you have with me?  I am a very busy man. . .
135-progress.title: The Defias Brotherhood

141-accept.name: Master Mathias Shaw
141-accept.text:
The Stonemasons' Guild was run by a man named Edwin VanCleef.  VanCleef was responsible for rebuilding Stormwind after the orcs razed it in the First War.  Apparently, VanCleef and his men were unhappy with their treatment by the King after the reconstruction was complete.  That just might explain a thing or two.

I have written a more detailed account for your Master in Westfall.  Take this to him at once!
141-accept.title: The Defias Brotherhood

1919-complete.name: Jennea Cannon
1919-complete.text: $N, I have a mission for you, here in the $c district.  Listen closely, for there is no time to waste.
1919-complete.title: Report to Jennea

1920-accept.name: Jennea Cannon
1920-accept.text:
A disturbance has been reported at the Blue Recluse tavern in the $C Quarter.  Strange, invisible creatures now wander the tavern, and I fear a mana rift has formed there.

I want you to investigate the tavern and capture those creatures.  Use the cantation of manifestation in the tavern to make the creatures visible, subdue them then use a containment coffer to capture them.  When you have enough, return to me with your filled coffers, your empty coffers and the cantation.
1920-accept.title: Investigate the Blue Recluse

1920-complete.name: Jennea Cannon
1920-complete.text:
Very well done!  I will study these creatures and, with diligence and luck, determine how they slipped into our world.

Your value to the society of mages grows, $N.
1920-complete.title: Investigate the Blue Recluse

1920-progress.name: Jennea Cannon
1920-progress.text: Have you captured the creatures, $N?  They must be studied in order to determine the reason behind their arrival.
1920-progress.title: Investigate the Blue Recluse

1921-accept.name: Jennea Cannon
1921-accept.text:
You have served your fellow mages well, and now it is time to don your wizard's robe.  Wynne Larson can make your robe, but you must bring her the needed materials  

The robe will be made of linen which is easy to find, but you must also gain charged rift gems, and the only known location of the gems is in the Silver Stream Mine of Loch Modan, left in crates by the dwarven miners' league.

Gather the linen and the gems and bring them to Wynne Larson at the Larson Clothiers in the $C District.
1921-accept.title: Gathering Materials

2040-accept.name: Shoni the Shilent
2040-accept.text:
Gnomeregan has fallen under the control of those dastardly troggs! The situation is grave but perhaps you can help, $N.

Deep in the Deadmines is a functional goblin shredder. Find that shredder and bring back the intact power supply. With the shredder's power supply, we can give our gyrodrillmatic excavationators the power they need to break through the rocky underground borders of Gnomeregan, opening the way for a gnomish assault!
2040-accept.title: Underground Assault

353-accept.name: Grimand Elmore
353-accept.text:
The Stormpikes are a respected dwarven clan, and are well known for their fine and discerning tastes.  So it's no wonder that Gringer Stormpike, a Mountaineer of Ironforge, commissioned me to craft him a weapon.

The weapon is finished, but... Mountaineer Stormpike is far away, in distant Loch Modan.  If you plan on traveling to the north, can you deliver this package to him?

My last message from Mountaineer Stormpike said he's stationed at the northern guard tower in Loch Modan.
353-accept.title: Stormpike's Delivery

399-complete.name: Baros Alexston
399-complete.text: Oh, thank you, $N! It's of no practical use to me, but the sentimental value... Needless to say, thank you for bringing this to me... at some cost to your own well-being, not to mention the time it took to go all the way down to Westfall. You have my gratitude, and have this as a token of my thanks.
399-complete.title: Humble Beginnings
